newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Kinnevik in distribution deal with Viacom.
newsitem.headline: Kinnevik in distribution deal with Viacom.

text.p: MTG, a media unit of Swedish industrial conglomerate Kinnevik on Tuesday announced an agreement with U.S. Viacom to distribute four television channels in the Nordic and Baltic regions.
The Modern Times Group (MTG) said in a statement that under the agreement it would distribute Nickelodeon, the Sci-Fi Channel, MTV and VH1 through the region.
"This is a very important, strategic development for MTG," said MTG's managing director Pelle Tornberg.
He said the transmission of Nickeloden, Sci-Fi Channel and VH1 would start from October 1 this year but the distribution of music channel MTV would not commence until the middle of 1998.
The channels would be transmitted through Nordic satellite company NSAB.
